sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.
3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is informant of this case and the case is pending for long time.
It is further submitted that although evidence of informant-applicant as PW-1 has been recorded but her cross-examination is still pending.

The trial court is not taking proper interest in disposal of her matter which relates to a major lady who was raped by her father-in-law.
4.

sentences.text: I have considered the submissions and perused the record.

From perusal of the record, it appears that the matter is pending at the stage of cross-examination of PW-1.
6.

In the facts and circumstances of the case, the learned trial court is directed to expedite the matter and complete the cross-examination of PW-1 within a period of one month from today and thereafter to decide the Session Trial No. 459 of 2024 (State of U.P. Vs. Moh. Aleem Baba) arising out of Case Crime No. 266 of 2024, under Section 376 I.P.C., Police Station Jiyanpur, District Azamgarh, expeditiously without granting unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties, if there is no legal impediment.

sentences.text:
7. It is also made clear that the Court/Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder in the trial and disposal of a case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and execution authorities, advocates, parties to the case, staff are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.
8. With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
